## TemplateEngine.\_processKeyboardBlocks() method

Extracts and parses `<keyboard>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processKeyboardBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: {
            inline?: string;
            bottom?: string;
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: { inline?: string; bottom?: string; }; }

A nested object mapping language keys to keyboard mode configurations

## Remarks

This internal method identifies all `<keyboard>` blocks and extracts their content organized by language and type (inline or bottom). Blocks without a `lang` attribute are stored under `"default"`<!-- -->. The `type` attribute defaults to `"inline"` unless explicitly set to `"bottom"`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <keyboard>Yes, No</keyboard>
  <keyboard type="bottom">Button 1, Button 2</keyboard>
  <keyboard lang="id">Ya, Tidak</keyboard>
`;
const keyboards = TemplateEngine._processKeyboardBlocks(template);
// Result: {
//   default: { inline: 'Yes, No', bottom: 'Button 1, Button 2' },
//   id: { inline: 'Ya, Tidak' }
// }
```
